QuestInfo.name: A Stroke of Genius
QuestInfo.0: Rat minions that have assumed the form of the temple's Trainees are guarding the front of the temple.
QuestInfo.1: Time to beat these rats at their own game! Transform yourself to look like a trainee and see if that'll get you through the door. Just focus your mind...
QuestInfo.2: You fooled the minions and gained entry to the inner temple. But as soon as you opened the door, the sight you saw surprised even you.
